name: Orvadal the Lost King
bio: Sorrow dogs Orvadal's every step. He was once a beloved Elder King, whose quest to shatter the Heart of Ice ended with him corrupted by its malign influence. Unable to return to Stoneloom and frozen on the edge of death, he now wanders Amara alone – seeking a cure that will one day free him from his icy torment.
